m: चल् (cf. √ चर् and also √ चट्) cl. 1. ˚लति (metrically also Ā. ˚ते; perf. चचाल pl. चेलुर्; fut. चलिष्यति; aor. अचालीत्), to be moved, stir, tremble, shake, quiver, be agitated, palpitate, MBh. &c.; to move on or forward, proceed, go away, start off, depart, MBh. (आसनेभ्यो ऽचलन्, ‘they rose from their seat’, v, 3114) &c.; to set (said of the day), Kathās. lxxii, 406; to be moved from one's usual course, be disturbed, become confused or disordered, go astray, MBh. &c.; to turn away from, swerve, deviate from (abl., e.g. धर्मात्, to swerve from virtue, Mn. vii, 15; MBh. ii, 2629), fall off (with abl.), MBh. &c.; to sport about, frolic, play (Dhātup. xxviii, 64), Kuval. 320 : Caus. चलयति (Pāṇ. i, 3, 87), to cause to move, move, shake, jog, push, agitate, disturb, Ragh. viii, 52; Ṛtus.; BhP.; Bhaṭṭ.; to cause to deviate, turn off from (abl.), Mṛcch. ix, 21 : Caus. चालय्˚ (Pass. चाल्यते) to cause to move, shake, jog, push, agitate, MBh. &c.; to drive, drive away, remove or expel from (abl.), MBh. i, 5743; xiii, 3336; Hariv. 2697; to disturb, make confused or disordered, MBh. xii; Vedāntas.; BhP. iii, 1, 42; to cause to deviate from (abl.), MBh. iii, 1504; R. iii; to cherish, foster, Dhātup. xxxii, 68 (v.l. for √ बल्) : Intens. चञ्चल्यते (cf. चञ्चल) or चाच्˚ (cf. अ-विचाचल ff.), Vop. xx, 8 f.;
चल् [cf. κέλω, κέλλω, ὀκέλλω, κέλης; Lat. celer, pro-cello, ex-.]
a: चल् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (चलति, rarely चलते, चचाल, अचालीत्, चलितुं, चलित) 1 To shake, tremble, move, throb, palpitate, stir; छिन्नाश्चेलुः क्षणं भुजाः Bk. 14. 40; सपक्षोद्रिरिवाचालीत् 15. 24; 6. 84. --2 (a) To go, move on, walk, stir or move (from one's place); पदात्पदमपि चलितुं न शक्नोति Pt. 4; च लत्येकेन पादेनतिष्ठत्येकेन बुद्धिमान् Chāṇ. 32; चचाल बाला स्तनभिन्नवल्कला Ku. 5. 84; Mk. 1. 56. (b) To proceed (on one's way), depart, set out, start off; चेलुश्चीरपरिग्रहाः Ku. 6. 92 vl. --3 To be affected, to be disturbed, confused or disordered (as mind), be agitated or perturbed; मुनेरपि यतस्तस्य दर्शनाच्चलते मनः Pt. 1. 400; लोभेन बुद्धिश्चलति H. 1. 140. --4 To deviate or swerve (with abl.); चलति नयान्न जिगीषतां हि चेतः Ki. 10. 29; to fall off, leave; Ms. 7. 15; Y. 1. 361. --Caus. (च-चा-लयति, चलित, चालित) 1 To cause to move, shake, stir; R. 8. 53. --2 To drive away, dismiss, remove or expel from; चाणक्ये चलिताधिकारविमुखे Mu. 4. 15. --3 To lead away from. --4 To cherish, foster (चालयति only). --5 To disturb, agitate; सुजनं जनाश्चलयितुं क ईशते Śi. 15. 40. {vII.v} {c6c} P. (चलति, चलित) To sport, play, frolic about.

a: चल — a. [चल्-अच्] 1 (a) {{Moving->Moving,||20240126|Scott Rhodes||Added comma for clarity. Rest are separated by comma. Here, it was only a line break.}} trembling, shaking, tremulous, rolling (as eyes &c); चलापांगां दृष्टिं स्पृशसि Ś. 1. 24 चलकाकपक्षकैरमात्यपुत्रैः R. 3. 28. waving; Bh. 1. 16. (b) Moveable (opp. स्थिर), moving; चले लक्ष्ये Ś. 2. 5; परिचयं चललक्ष्यनिपातने R. 9. 49. --2 Unsteady, fickle, inconstant, loose, unfixed: दयितास्वनवस्थितं नृणां न खलु प्रेम चलं सुहृज्जने Ku. 4. 28; प्रायश्चलं गौरवमाश्रितषु 3. 1. --3 Frail, transitory, perishable; चला लक्ष्मीश्चलाः प्राणाश्चलं जीवितयौवनं Bh. 3. 128. --4 Confused. --लः 1 Trembling, shaking, agitation. --2 Wind. --3 Quicksilver. --4 The supreme being. --ला 1 Lakṣmī, the goddess of wealth. --2 Lightning. --3 A kind of perfume. --Comp. --अचल a. {1} moveable and immovable. {2} fickle, unsteady, very transitory (= अतिचल); चलाचले च संसारे धर्म एको हि निश्चलः Bh. 3. 128; लक्ष्मीमिव चलाचलां Ki. 11. 30 (चलाचल = चंचला Malli.); कस्य न भवति चलाचलं धनं Mk. 2. 14; N. 1. 60. --(लः) a crow. --आतंकः rheumatism. --आत्मन् a. inconstant, fickle-minded. --इंद्रिय a. {1} sensitive. {2} sensual. --इषुः one whose arrow flies unsteadily or misses the mark, a bad archer. --कर्णः the true distance of a planet from the earth. --चंचुः the Cakora bird. --चित्त a. fickle-minded. --दलः, --पत्रः the Aśvattha tree. --संधिः moveable articulation of the bones.

चलत्—पदम् ind. so as to move, W.
चलत्-सट mfn. with flying mane, Bcar.
चल—त्व n. id., Hariv. 2893; Megh. 94.
चलेन्द्रिय mfn. having unsteady organs, W.

v: pu॰ calo lakzyamaprApta izuryasya । lakzyamaprAptavARake mandaDAnuzke । atra “udarASvezu kzepe” pA॰ izu Sabdepare kzepe pUrvvapUrvvapadasyAntodAttatAviGAnAt pUrvvapadramantodAttam ।
m: चलेषु for चलाचल्˚, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 108, Sch.
चलि m. a cover, W.
a surtout, W.

s: tri, (cala + karttari ktaH .) kampitam । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 87 ॥ (yaTA, rAjataraNgiRyAm । 5 । 365 । “tayorvilAsavalitEScalitApANgaviBramEH ॥”) gatam । cala ja gatAvitidarSanAt ॥ (yaTA, goH rAmAyaRe । 3 । 57 । 23 । “aDirUQe gajArohe yaTAsyAccalitogajaH ॥”)
v: tri॰ cala--karttari kta । 1 kampite amaraH । 2 gate “calitavarvalapakzaparigrahaH” “calitaH puraH patimupetamAtmajam” mAGaH । 2 prApte 3 jYAte ca tri॰ । BAve kta । 4 calane 5 gatO” ca na॰ ।
m: चलित mfn. shaking, tremulous, unfixed, MBh. &c.
one who has moved on MBh.; Sūryas. iii, 11
gone, departed (e.g. स चलितः, ‘he started off’, Pañcat.; Gīt. iii, 3; Hit.)
walked, Vet. iii, 1/2 (v.l.)
being on the march (an army), L.
moved from one's usual course, disturbed, disordered (the mind, senses, fortune, &c.), Hariv. 5669; R. &c.
caused to deviate, turned off from (abl.), Yājñ. i, 360; Bhag. vi, 37
चलित n. unsteady motion (of eyes), Bhartṛ. i, 4.
चलित &c. See √ चल्.
a: चलित — p. p. [चल्-क्त] 1 Shaken, moved, stirred, agitated. --2 Gone, departed; एवमुक्त्वा स चलितः. --3 Attained. --4 Known, understood. --5 Removed, displaced. (see चल्). --तं 1 Shaking, moving. --2 Going, walking. --3 A kind of dance; चलितं नाम नाट्यमंतरंण M. 1.

k.v: स्यादासारः प्रसरणं प्रचक्रं चलितार्थकम्. अहितान्प्रत्यभीतस्य रणे यानमभिक्रमः॥

m: चलित—स्थान mfn. changing its place, R. (B) iv, 1, 14.
चलितव्य n. impers. to be gone away, R. iii.
चलोर्मि mfn. having agitated waves, R. i, 14, 18; Megh. 25.
चलु m. a mouthful of water, L.

s: puM, (calunA kAyatIti । kE + kaH .) prasftiH । BARqaBedaH । iti medinI । ke, 86 ॥
v: pu॰ calunA mIyate kan । 1 prasftO 2 BARqaBede ca medi॰ ।
m: चलुक m. (= चुल्˚) id., Pañcat. i
a small pot, gallipot, L.
N. of a man, W.
a: चलुकः — [चलुना मीयते कन् Tv.] 1 Water taken up in the hollowed palm for rinsing the mouth. --2 A handful or mouthful (of water); cf. चुलुक.
